recipes.name: Roasted Lotus Seeds

recipes.name: Roasted Mighty Thistle

recipes.name: Roasted Armoranth

recipes.name: Roasted Swift Carrot
recipes.description: A fragrant swift carrot that's been lightly roasted. It doesn't have any special effects, but it will restore some health.

recipes.name: Roasted Endura Carrot
recipes.description: This flame-kissed endura carrot makes for a truly extravagant single-item dish. The fire really brought out its sweetness.

recipes.name: Baked Fortified Pumpkin
recipes.description: This fortified pumpkin has been roasted whole. The hard rind serves as a container for the steamed pumpkin flesh inside.

recipes.name: Baked Sun Pumpkin
recipes.description: A large, whole, roasted sun pumpkin. It lost its original effect in the baking process, but it's soft and tasty.

recipes.name: Roasted Radish
recipes.description: A roasted hearty radish. Fragrant and warm, it has no special effect but will restore hearts.

recipes.name: Roasted Big Radish
recipes.description: A roasted big hearty radish. To take such a precious vegetable and put it to the fire is decadent in a way.

recipes.name: Toasty Skyshroom
recipes.description: A simply grilled skyshroom. The heat brings out its flavor and increases the amount of health it can restore.

recipes.name: Toasty Hylian Shroom
recipes.description: A Hylian shroom toasted to perfection. The taste and fragrance are amplified, restoring more health to its consumer.

recipes.name: Toasty Stamella Shroom
recipes.description: This toasted stamella shroom doesn't grant any special effects, but it will restore a bit of health.

recipes.name: Toasty Rushroom
recipes.description: A rushroom that's been put to the torch. It may have lost its speedy properties, but at least it tastes good now.

recipes.name: Toasty Sunshroom
recipes.description: It's always a good idea to keep a fully roasted sunshroom or two on hand just in case. Eat it to recover a bit of health.

recipes.name: Toasty Chillshroom
recipes.description: A fully roasted chillshroom. It's evenly toasted and tastes a lot better than when eaten raw. Eating it will restore a bit of health.

recipes.name: Toasty Zapshroom
recipes.description: It's not very shocking that this fully roasted zapshroom is delicious. Eat it to recover a bit of health.

recipes.name: Toasty Razorshroom
recipes.description: A razorshroom that's been exposed to direct heat. Its sharp exterior has softened considerably. Restores a bit of health.

recipes.name: Toasty Ironshroom
recipes.description: An ironshroom exposed to an open flame. Its once-tough exterior is now crunchy and tasty. Restores a bit of health.

recipes.name: Toasty Silent Shroom
recipes.description: A whole, toasted silent shroom. High heat may have destroyed its soft glow, but it's now fragrant and tasty.

recipes.name: Toasty Brightcap
recipes.description: A whole, roasted brightcap. Sure, it loses its bioluminescent enzymes, but it's softer and easier to chew.

recipes.name: Toasty Endura Shroom
recipes.description: A toasted endura shroom. It doesn't grant any special effects, but boy is it tasty!

recipes.name: Toasted Hearty Truffle
recipes.description: A hearty truffle toasted until its outside is crispy. It tastes great, but hearty truffles are far more effective when cooked in a recipe.

recipes.name: Toasted Big Hearty Truffle
recipes.description: This big hearty truffle has been roasted whole. It gets full points for aroma and nutrition. Eat it to recover a lot of hearts.

recipes.name: Seared Steak
recipes.description: Meat cooked over an open flame. Cooking it has increased its flavor and the number of hearts it provides.

recipes.name: Seared Prime Steak
recipes.description: Prime meat cooked over an open flame. The outside is perfectly browned, while the inside is mouthwateringly juicy.

recipes.name: Seared Gourmet Steak
recipes.description: The highest quality gourmet meat, just kissed by an open flame. No additional seasonings have been added, which lets the natural flavor of the meat really shine.

recipes.name: Roasted Bird Drumstick
recipes.description: Bird drumstick that's been cooked to a crisp, skin and all. It's devoid of seasoning, but it has a simple, accessible taste. Restores more hearts than the raw variety.

recipes.name: Roasted Bird Thigh
recipes.description: Prime meat that's been flame-seared to perfection. The outside is crispy, but the inside is juicy. Eat it to recover hearts.

recipes.name: Roasted Whole Bird
recipes.description: This whole bird has been tickled by an open flame to bring out its flavor. Less is more, as the lack of additional seasoning allows its natural taste to shine.

recipes.name: Roasted Arowana
recipes.description: A whole, grilled ancient arowana. The meat is cooked through and has reached a perfect tenderness.

recipes.name: Roasted Bass

recipes.name: Roasted Trout

recipes.name: Roasted Carp

recipes.name: Roasted Porgy

recipes.name: Roasted Cave Fish
